notes: §1985:IX.4.5.4 GR18, the indexed twin of GR16 of the relative module: a record outside the minimum or maximum is delivered (a long one truncated) and the READ is successful with the record length conflict status, 04 (§1985:IX.1.3.4 GRL2.1). Measured against the reading connector's own record size (§1985:II.2.1), reading B, as for 1985-GR-VIII.4.5.4-16. kb/Work PB5480: a connector opened INPUT on a zero-byte file read records written later by another connector outside its bounds with 00, because the zero-byte OPEN validates nothing. IndexedConnector.ReadSequential and ReadRandom now answer 04 through IndexedReadStatus, which asks FileConnector.RecordLengthConflicts (own probe ixzero: RANDOM 04/04/00, NEXT 04/04/00 against records of 4, 20 and 7 characters under RECORD VARYING 5 TO 10; controls ixsep 00). With the length conflict and a following duplicate key both true the one status is 04 (a determination, docs/CONFORMANCE.md): GR18 states the conflict as the READ's own outcome while 02 only reports a neighbour.

next.reason: 1985 states for indexed files that a record shorter than the minimum leaves the rest of the record area undefined and a longer one is truncated on the right, READ successful with a length-conflict status. 2023 confines that text to 'For a record sequential file' (§2023:14.9.30.4 GR14, which therefore states nothing for indexed files); for an indexed READ only the successful status 04 remains (§2023:9.1.13.2 GR3). The record-area content and truncation for an indexed file are no longer specified.
